title_seed: 先前的『通過』可能需要被撤回
central_problem: finalizer 如果只看 rows、不看 canonical owner state，會不會把 blocked source 報成 qualifying？
reader_takeaway: closure audit 不只是整理報表；它可以撤回沒有通過 authority binding 的表面 success。

known_at_the_time.fact: sealed read-only audit found that the legal OA V4 finalizer projected every canonicalAdmissionRows member as admitted without checking canonical state。
the defensible minimum after override was 3/10 qualifying cases, not the original generated 4/10 projection。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: the audit preserved the original generated PARTIAL output but marked it superseded by the canonical-binding audit。

not_yet_available.fact: the overridden QA result was not followed by a content rerun; it is a correction of the evidence record, not a new cohort。

observed_failures.symptom: a qualifying artifact belonged to a source whose canonical owner state was BLOCKED
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: finalizer failed to check canonical state before projecting admission
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: original PARTIAL projection could not stand as final
observed_failures.later_resolution: sealed post-closure override blocked the claim and retained the audit trail

observed_failures.symptom: nominal 3-query/3-provider cascade expanded to 22 queries, 6 providers and 90 attempt rows
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: planner-level limits were not equivalent to side-effect-level accounting
observed_failures.later_resolution: V5 introduced authoritative pre-side-effect execution ledger

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: One audited cascade expanded to 22 queries, 6 providers and 90 attempt rows; the post-closure audit set a defensible minimum of 3/10 qualifying cases.
tests_and_metrics.result: superseded result retained and corrected by canonical state

engineering_decisions.decision: 以 canonical owner state 覆核 finalizer projection，並將 superseded result 保留為審計紀錄而非刪除。

architecture_state.state: canonical admission → finalizer/manifest projection → sealed closure audit

safe_numbers.meaning: one audited cascade; not a universal system count

safe_public_facts.fact: 如果 summary layer 漏看 authority layer，系統可能把不應該通過的結果報成通過；因此 closure 也要能做 binding audit。

retrospective_notes.note: 這個 audit 直接促成下一日的 authoritative execution budget；不要把 V5 內容提前寫成已完成。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: sealed superseding audit and fan-out finding

publication_risks: 必須明確標示原始 PARTIAL 已被 supersede。
不要公開 raw attempt rows 或 internal IDs。
